name: Iori
message: 「......Match decided！！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Acknowledging the dissipation of Suzakuin Momiji's Barrier Jacket on the west side」

name: Iori
message: 「Therefore, victory goes to Kazamine Setsugekka on the east side！！！」
There are no cheers. No words of praise either.
Only the quiet presence of the night praised the hard-fought battle between the two.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa, haa... hah... huh...？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I won？ I beat Momimomi？」
I help Setsugekka up as she staggers to her feet.

name: Iori
message: 「That's right. You won, Setsugekka」
Keisetsu runs over to Setsugekka, who is standing frozen with a blank look on her face.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You did it, Setsugekka！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um... did I really win...？ Does that mean I was stronger than Momimomi...？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, you were」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see... I won... I beat Momimomi...！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「......Yeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeah！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I won！ I beat Momimomiiiiii！！！」
Setsugekka, jumping up and down with joy despite staggering just moments ago.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It's a win for Always-Beats-Suzakuin-Man~~~！！」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Not 'always'」
Staggering to her feet, Momiji makes her way over to us too.

name: Momiji
message: 「It's still one win to one loss」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you okay, Momiji?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well... my body's fine」

name: Momiji
message: 「Though I honestly thought I was a goner when that sword-of-light thing came right at me...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Heh-heh~ Did you see that?! My ultimate move!!!」
She clenches her fist tight and flashes a smug grin.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, could you quiet down a little？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-alright……」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Momiji-san, do you remember our promise, I wonder」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you lose, you will accept any single demand from Kazamine」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The scope of demands is everything within the power of Suzakuin's next head. There's no mistake here, right？」
Keisetsu confirms with Momiji.

name: Momiji
message: 「Of course. A warrior never goes back on her word. Ask for whatever you like.」
……With Momiji's defeat, the "Never Let the Green Grass Wither" operation ended in de facto failure.
I couldn't imagine what would happen from here on out.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「This is a historic victory, Setsugekka. Now then, what should I have her grant me……！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Eventually having the Suzakuin Family join the Kazamine Group is also an option for a demand, isn't it？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Maybe. But I'm not the head yet, so that's impossible.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, of course I understand that. I'll ask after Momiji-san becomes the head of the Suzakuin Family」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「No, rather than that, having Momiji-san marry someone from Kazamine and bringing the headship into Kazamine is also on the table！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Wait, if we do that, there's also the possibility Momiji-san would lose her right of succession as head of the Suzakuin Family」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Either way, there's no need to decide hastily right here. Aah…… my dreams just keep growing」
Keisetsu is more excited than she has ever been before. It was a sight rarely seen.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Kei-chan」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Give me a little time, I want to think this through slowly」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I said Kei-chan！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What is it, Setsugekka. I'm in the middle of talking with Momiji-san……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The one who won this match was me, right」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, you were」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then I have decision-making authority too, don't I？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「……Well, yes, that's true enough.」
Perhaps because it was unexpected, Keisetsu stumbled over her words.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Still, this is an extremely important matter. I would like you to leave contract matters like this to me, though.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I know you're good at this sort of thing, Kei-chan, but I'm the one who worked hard...？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, this victory would not have been possible without your strength. I understand that, however—」
Keisetsu and Setsugekka began to argue.
...Or so I thought, when Momiji nudged me repeatedly with her elbow.
Momiji was trying to tell me something with her eyes.
It seemed she wanted me to take some kind of action, though I had no idea what I was supposed to do.

name: Iori
message: （Well... I guess it's better than just sitting around waiting）
...Even though it had been intermittent, the conversation the two of them had during the match had reached me.
Setsugekka and Momiji shared the same wish. If so, there might still be hope.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, you have no idea how difficult it is to gain the upper hand over the Suzakuin.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「This opportunity could decide the next 100 years of the Kazamine's future... That is how critical a juncture this is.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Do you have the resolve to steer that course？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, I... I don't, but...」
Talked down by Keisetsu, Setsugekka drooped dejectedly.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「As members of the Kazamine, we have a duty to guide the clan's future toward a better path.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Acting recklessly out of personal greed is unacceptable for the next head of the Kazamine.」
Lectured by Keisetsu, she fell silent.

name: Iori
message: 「...Keisetsu, aren't you being a bit too harsh?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Muragaki-san, this is a Kazamine family matter and has nothing to do with you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Maybe so, but I'm a teacher to both of you. When something's wrong, I'm going to call it out.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「My, and what exactly am I wrong about？」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka's the one who worked hard in this match and seized the victory. When it comes to the right the Kazamine won, you should hear Setsugekka's opinion first.」

name: Iori
message: 「Taking that right away from the one who contributed the most and silencing her voice doesn't sit right with me.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...I believe I've told you this before, though」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka and I are twins—two halves split from a single cell. We are the right hand and the left, each making up for what the other lacks.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I act for Setsugekka, and Setsugekka acts for me. That is how the two of us have always lived.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「The authority I hold belongs to Setsugekka, and vice versa. That is how we live.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I won't allow anyone, no matter who they may be, to meddle in that.」
Keisetsu delivers the warning with an even heavier air of intimidation than usual. Still, none of that matters to me.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, are you really okay with that？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Because Kei-chan is always right.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan doesn't act for her own sake. She's always acting for the Kazamine family—for everyone.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Meanwhile, I'm always only thinking about myself. I truly respect Kei-chan, and I think she's amazing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Compared to her, my own wishes are just childish, self-centered, and purely selfish...」
I see... So that's what you've been thinking.
Because you have an incredible big sister who's always on your side—an all-too-admirable sister who's always right beside you—leaving you unable to say a thing.
And just like that, you've been killing your true self all along—

name: Iori
message: 「...Setsugekka, let me teach you something important as your teacher.」

name: Iori
message: 「There isn't just one kind of righteousness. There are as many as there are people.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone carries their own justice in their heart, and no one's righteousness ranks above or below another's.」

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu's righteousness is admirable and wonderful. Even so, that doesn't shake your own righteousness in the slightest, Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「It's okay for you to have a justice that's yours and yours alone...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A justice all my own...」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, you admired heels, didn't you.」

name: Iori
message: 「You wanted to become like Nakamura Sakura—a player who freely blurts out whatever she wants to say in whatever words she pleases.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why did you admire her? Because that's who you truly want to be！！」

name: Iori
message: 「...You have a twin sister who is overwhelmingly kind, overwhelmingly strong, and overwhelmingly smart.」

name: Iori
message: 「She's always on your side, someone you can't live without. That's why you've never been able to push back against her until now.」

name: Iori
message: 「But really, somewhere deep down in your heart, you were thinking it, weren't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「That Keisetsu's righteousness can eat shit！！！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Muragaki-san, I can't let that remark slide. Would you stop trying to steer Setsugekka's thoughts？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「If you keep up this outrage any longer, I'll resort to appropriate measures myself……！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, bring it on! Come at me! If you think you can do whatever you want with Muragaki, the master-swordsman slayer, that is！！」
There is nothing to be afraid of.
I don't hesitate for a second to call something wrong when I think it's wrong.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka! Remember Ririmu! What did she value most of all！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Deciding things for yourself and not letting anyone butt in…… that's Ririmu-chan's worldview……！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's right. What's wrong with being selfish?」
From here on out, you'll step out into society and learn that selfishness alone won't get you through the world.
But finding that out can wait for much later. Right now, you just have to be selfish and live true to what you believe.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……But Kei-chan always helped me. I have to help Kei-chan too」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Otherwise, I'll end up as an unwanted kid……！」

name: Momiji
message: 「……Setsugekka, I'm right here」

name: Momiji
message: 「If Keisetsu says she doesn't want you, I'll take you for myself」
Saying that, Momiji gently takes Setsugekka's hand.

name: Momiji
message: 「I have no intention of ever letting go」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Momiji……！」
The sparkle returned to Setsugekka's wilted eyes.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Yeah, you're right」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Even Momimomi gathered her courage and put it into words, so I'll gather my courage and say it too……！」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm cheering for you, do your best」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Hey, Kei-chan. I have a favor to ask」
Setsugekka turns back to face Keisetsu.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What is it」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Let me decide the wish for Momimomi. I'm the one who won, so it's okay for me to decide, right?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Momimomi, any one wish from Kazamine」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, what is it?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Help Kei-chan become the head of the Kazamine Family.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Is that all you want？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, that's fine.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「W-Wait！ Instead of something so mercenary, there are far better demands you could make going forward…！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If the next head of the Suzakuin promises it, we're set. It's already decided that Kei-chan will be the next head of the Kazamine！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Nobody can know that for sure！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Also, I want Mr. Muragaki to be able to stay at this academy after summer break.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Isn't that something you should ask Keisetsu？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right. Kei-chan, can you do that？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, give it a rest. Keep messing around like this and I'll get mad too…！」
Setsugekka earned a glare from Keisetsu. Even so, Setsugekka didn't back down.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm not messing around. I'm asking seriously.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「What are you thinking, Setsugekka?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「…After all, I don't want to leave this academy. I want to stay here and do Jindou with everyone.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, that's just being selfish. It's unforgivable for the next head of the Kazamine！！」
At the furious Keisetsu, Setsugekka lowered her eyes sadly.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan… Kei-chan is the only one who'll become head.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I can't become head, and I have no intention of doing it.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, you…」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whenever I was troubled, Kei-chan always listened to me with genuine care.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You thought through solutions with me, and you granted so many of my selfish wishes.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka…」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I love Kei-chan and I'm truly grateful, so I could never bring myself to say it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I didn't want to betray Kei-chan, who's so important to me, and I just couldn't make up my mind until now.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「…But you know, fighting Momiji here and now made me realize.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan, there's something I want to do myself.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Just as hard as you're working to become the family head, I have something I want to work hard for, too.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But what I want to do isn't the same as yours, Kei-chan.」
Resolutely, she tells Keisetsu.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「—I want to become the Toujinegi at this academy.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I managed to beat her once, so it shouldn't be impossible. Next time, I'm going to beat Momiji on the Martial Festival stage.」
Setsugekka clenches her fist tightly.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan... thank you for helping me all this time.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whenever you're in trouble, I'll definitely come to help you. I'll do everything I can to help your dream come true.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But... I can't go with you anymore.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka…」
At a loss for words, Keisetsu falls silent.
However—it was only for a brief moment.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...I see. I understand.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I'm sorry I didn't notice.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Before I knew it, perhaps I had begun to take it for granted that you would follow me.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Somewhere inside, I was presuming on your quiet forbearance.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「But that's over now, too. It's going to be lonely.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm sorry, Kei-chan...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「We've walked together all this time, but... today we part ways, Setsugekka.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I will walk the path I believe in.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「So, Setsugekka, stay true to your own path.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah... yeah, thank you, Kei-chan！」
Wiping away her tears, Setsugekka smiles.

name: Iori
message: 「I'm glad she understood, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah... Thank you, Muragaki-sensei！！」

name: Iori
message: 「I didn't do anything. Momiji's the one who put in the work.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, I know, but I don't want to thank Momiji. So I figured I'd thank you instead, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「What's that supposed to mean?」
I can't help but let out a wry smile.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Keisetsu, I've got a few favors to ask of you too.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You too？ Give me a break already, won't you？」
Perhaps thoroughly worn out from dealing with Setsugekka, she wears a wry smile.

name: Momiji
message: 「For starters, I want an audience with the head of the Kazamine Family.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Then, I'll lay out all the benefits the Kazamine Family stands to gain by making you the next head.」

name: Momiji
message: 「And I'll guarantee it myself, as the next head of the Suzakuin Family.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...A-Are you serious about that？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yes. I'll definitely keep the promise Setsugekka just made. I'll make you the head of the Kazamine.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I see... I truly appreciate the intention, but...」

name: Momiji
message: 「Which brings me to my other favor.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Turn down the current Kazamine head's request and stay here at this academy.」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you do, I think I can offer you an even more attractive support package, you know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I've already put together some materials with the details of the plan, so please give it some thought~」
Momiji casually tosses something toward Keisetsu. It's probably holographic data.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Heh, hehe, ahahahaha!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I give up. You had all of this planned out from the very beginning？ You really got the better of me, Momiji-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「From the beginning？ What do you mean？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「It means Momiji-san challenged me to a duel after already preparing for how things would play out if Setsugekka won.」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？！ Is that true？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, it was my first time using Shingan no Kiwamete for a scheme like this, so I wasn't sure if it'd actually work.」
Momiji, sticking out her tongue playfully.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In other words, I'd already lost the moment I went along with the deal. I took the bait hook, line, and sinker.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hold on, wasn't Operation 'Never Let the Green Grass Wither' supposed to depend on Momiji winning...！」

name: Momiji
message: 「My calculations showed we had better odds of winning if I let you think that, Sensei~」

name: Iori
message: 「S-Seriously...！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「From the very start, Momiji-san factored in the possibility that fighting the duel would lead Setsugekka and me to part ways.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「You were talking to Setsugekka during the duel, weren't you？ You put all sorts of ideas in her head and steered things to turn out this way.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Don't make it sound so shady. All I did was share my sincere feelings with Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「I couldn't really make out the details, so what exactly did you tell her？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Th-That's a secret!」
Huh, oh well. I'll ask Setsugekka next time.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, Setsugekka really loves you, Iori-sensei. I figured with your persuasion, it'd work out.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「In any case, win or lose, Momiji-san intended to get her demands through.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Truly, the Suzakuins are unfathomable...」
Keisetsu, looking utterly drained.
Apparently, every single one of us had been dancing right in the palm of Momiji's hand.

name: Momiji
message: 「...You said something about a right hand and a left hand, Keisetsu, but...」

name: Momiji
message: 「If the right hand and the left hand each have their own separate brain attached, of course they're going to move separately. Isn't that just how it goes？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, perhaps you're right.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, one of those brains is so completely busted that I guess it's only natural you'd act like it isn't even there~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, I just sensed you dissing me just now! Watch it!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Her sense of smell is sharp to make up for it, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「True enough.」
Keisetsu and Momiji giggle together.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey~, what's with the two of you, geez!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「More importantly, what did you end up deciding？」
All eyes turn to Keisetsu.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Haa…… It's not really the outcome I wanted, though.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「As a result, letting Setsugekka have her way as-is turned out to be the best choice for Kazamine.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Therefore, I'm turning down the current head's request. Both I and Setsugekka will remain at this academy for the time being.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「R-Really……！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「What about Iori-sensei？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Since both I and Setsugekka are staying, maintaining the status quo is naturally the optimal solution.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「As for Muragaki-san, I will use every means available to consult with those above so he can continue running ‘errands’ just like this.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……Th-Thank you, Kei-chan！！」
Setsugekka hugs Keisetsu as if pouncing on her.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Thank you, thank you so much……！！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Wha…… Setsugekka, you have crazy strength, so hold back a little…… It hurts……！」
Hugging Keisetsu with all her might in her excitement, Setsugekka makes Keisetsu's eyes roll back.

name: Momiji
message: 「We did it, Sensei. The plan was a huge success.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah！！」
Bumping fists with Momiji.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Waa, thank goodness~！ We did it~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I am truly glad everything settled peacefully.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, right!! ……Wait, Ririmu and Asahi!？」
Ririmu and Asahi jumped out from the bushes.

name: Momiji
message: 「You guys, don't tell me you were hiding there the whole time？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, duh, it was a duel between Secchan and Momitchi! Even if you told us no, of course we'd watch!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Fufufu, I took the liberty of filming the entire match with a telephoto stealth drone.」

name: Asahi
message: 「As for the two of you bickering, I recorded it cleanly with a high-performance directional microphone, so please don't worry.」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-Whaaaat！？ No way！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that so? I'd really like to hear that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「At graduation, we will screen it as a memorial movie in the director's cut, so please look forward to it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Stoooop！ That's guaranteed to become my darkest secret！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What, what？ What are you guys talking about？」
Having finished chewing Keisetsu out, Setsugekka came over to us.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Good for you, Secchan~！ We'll still be together from now on！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, yeah！ Thanks~, Ririmu-chan！」
The two of them hugging each other tightly.

name: Asahi
message: 「Well done, Momiji-san. That was a truly impressive read.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehe, I went a little all-out this time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That aside, you're going to delete the audio and video, right？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, I'm looking forward to the future.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Uwaaah~, you have zero intention of deleting it, do you！」
Everyone looks uniformly happy.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm going to be able to keep doing Jindou. It's all thanks to you and Momimomi, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, this is something you won for yourself, Setsugekka. You did great, Setsugekka.」
It was Setsugekka who first got through to Keisetsu.
If Setsugekka hadn't summoned the courage to express her true feelings, things surely wouldn't have turned out like this.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-And, um...」
Setsugekka, looking like she's having a hard time bringing something up.

name: Iori
message: 「What's wrong？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Muragaki-sensei, are you going to keep being a teacher？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No matter how much Kei-chan and I say we're staying here, it won't mean anything if you're gone, Sensei.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Sensei, until we graduate... will you always stay our teacher...？」
At Setsugekka's question—Momiji, Asahi, Ririmu, and Keisetsu too. Everyone in Takamura Class is listening closely.
...I can't keep being a teacher.
I stole my best friend's dream; I have no right to chase a dream of my own. I've lived my whole life believing that.
But that—

name: Takahisa
message: 『Do it, become a teacher.』

name: Takahisa
message: 『Iori, live the way you want to live.』
Because my best friend―Takahisa―said so.

name: Iori
message: 「……Yeah, of course.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even after the Martial Festival ends, after summer ends, when winter comes, when spring comes, and next year too！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'm staying on as a teacher—！！」
This place, this time, and the classmates right beside you now will become a lifelong treasure for you all.
I said that—but it was the same for me.

name: Iori
message: 「The time I spend with you all from now on will become a lifelong treasure for me, too……！」
Even after graduation, through good times and hard times, life goes on.
For the future beyond that, and above all for right here, right now.

name: Iori
message: 「So let's live through this time together！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Muragaki-sensei…… yes！！」
If we do that, I'm sure we'll be able to say when we look back on today.
That the three years we spent at this academy were the best time ever—

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, everyone. Summer break starts tomorrow.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's head back to our family homes and let loose to our heart's content！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, that's right.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's train during summer break too, and get even stronger together！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, please.」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's play a lot and do lots of fun things！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, let's party hard~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Let's keep work in moderation and make time for everyone！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Fufu, I'll do my best.」
The smiles everyone gave back were so dazzling.
There was still a mountain of things I wanted to tell everyone. I wanted to talk about what comes next.
But, for the time being.

name: Iori
message: 「It's hard to say goodbye, but—Takamura Class, dismissed for the day！！！」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes」
